completeCurrentCard.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. One perceived creature with line of effect makes a CHA save. NEW: a willing creature can elect failure before the roll. Success causes no application; failure establishes a nonconcentration lock lasting 24 elapsed hours. Record each currently defined effective canonical alignment axis; undefined axes remain undefined and unprotected. While operative, the lock prevents a recorded effective value from being replaced by a different one. It neither reveals values nor compels conduct. Underlying progression, Corrupted and other independent records continue to change and remain recorded, but a locked axis exposes its fixed value to mechanical alignment queries until the lock ends. Display-only masks retain their own rules and do not become actual state changes. NEW: use the earliest active eligible lock for each axis; later conflicting applications retain their own snapshots and deadlines but are suppressed for that axis. Ending exposes the current underlying state without restoring an old baseline or erasing another source’s record. Suppression retains the clock and can expose underlying changes without replaying them when the lock resumes. A prevented transition does not refund a paid cost or queue a later free attempt. Explicit absolute-source exceptions and information protections retain their scope. This grants no moral judgment, oath override or personality restriction.

CURRENT INTERFACE — NEW scoped exception `AC4-ALIGN-01` for Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor versus reviewed Alignment Purge/Suggestion. A Lock/Anchor application freezes only the effective defined axis value it actually snapshots; it does not delete, prevent creation of, pause, refund, or rewrite an underlying Alignment Suggestion, Alignment Purge, or independent lawful alignment record. For effective-alignment reads on a locked axis, evaluate the ordinary underlying history and reviewed Suggestion/Purge interaction (including AP-AS-01) first, then apply the active Lock/Anchor snapshot last. Thus a Purge or Suggestion cast after a lock can establish its own live record and pay/keep its own costs and clock, but cannot change the locked effective axis while that lock remains active. When a new Suggestion computes its target baseline, exclude prior Suggestion overlays and Purge overlays as AP-AS-01 already requires, and additionally exclude AC4 Lock/Anchor overlays on the target so the lock cannot become a ratchet staircase. A Purge on the Suggestion caster still affects that caster's own effective orientation normally. If Lock/Anchor is applied while Purge or Suggestion is already effective, it snapshots the currently effective defined value; later ending/suppression of the lower overlay does not alter that snapshot. When Lock/Anchor ends or is inactive because a zone was exited/suppressed, the then-live lower lawful result becomes effective immediately with its original deadline/history; no old snapshot is restored and no missed application replays. Undefined axes are never fabricated.

Ten minutes = 100 future caster regular-start markers or 600 elapsed seconds. Alignment Lock uses 24 elapsed hours; rank-7 Alignment Anchor uses seven elapsed days; Bind Element uses two future target regular ends / 12 elapsed seconds outside initiative. Preserve that fixed virtual/absolute deadline across initiative entry/exit, reorder, extra turns, absence, caster death and suppression. Caster death alone does not end Spell Shield.

operationalCandidate.completeProcedure:
KEEP Action/V/S/F/base 17 RP, one perceived creature within 120 feet and line of effect, and a Wisdom save negating the effect. NEW choose a temporary True Neutral effective-alignment overlay, not absence of alignment, general predicate suppression or a new moral classification. On a failed binary save and absent an actual applicable immunity, establish concentration for at most 60 elapsed seconds from resolution. Ordinary natural 1/20 do not shift the save. Charmed-only immunity does not stop a spell that imposes no Charmed condition; a genuine broader or alignment-alteration immunity keeps its actual scope. No repeat application/ending save or daily immunity is invented.

NEW explicit undefined-record boundary: this overlay requires both real defined canonical mechanical axes; a genuinely unaligned/no-record creature or a record with an undefined axis is not converted into fabricated Neutral data. Hidden target alignment need not be known by the caster: the ordinary perceived-creature cast commits and resolves its save without a free alignment preflight; missing/undefined qualification creates no overlay and no diagnostic alignment disclosure/refund. An already True Neutral creature with both defined axes can still receive the overlay after a failed save; it can cover later independent changes while live. The lawful underlying record is never overwritten.

Use Neutral/Neutral as effective alignment for rules whose actual predicate queries current effective canonical alignment, including genuine source-qualified alignment damage/detection/item/spell requirements. Rules requiring underlying/permanent identity, actual conduct, earned lineage, acquisition snapshots or independently recorded tags continue to require those facts. There is no new feat/class/spell/item acquisition, loss, healing, RP refill, oathbreak, atonement waiver, forced belief, loyalty, command, Charm or hard-control grant. A live power rechecking effective alignment may cease/resume only under its own dependency rule; a completed independent effect is not generically undone or recast. The underlying source and used allowances survive.

NEW named exception AP-AS-01 to reviewed Alignment Suggestion, not a claim that the old card already excluded Purge: while an actual unsuppressed Purge operates, evaluate its two Neutral values after Suggestion's live fixed changed-axis values, regardless of their cast order. Purge does not delete Suggestion, stop its concentration, extend its own source deadline or alter its source rank. When casting a new Suggestion on this recipient, compute the target baseline with every previous Suggestion overlay AND every Purge overlay on that target excluded, retaining all other actually authorized underlying changes and independent effects. Snapshot the Suggestion caster's own current effective orientation normally, including a genuine Purge on the caster if present. Compute the existing one-step shifts; only genuinely changed defined axes gain fixed Suggestion values. Its no-changed-axis/no-new-replacement rule remains. Thus Purge cannot become a target-side staircase, yet a Purged caster really has Neutral/Neutral for the existing caster-side snapshot.

Independent changes remain below the overlays with their real timestamps; ending Purge exposes the current live Suggestion/underlying result, not a restored old snapshot. Ending Suggestion while Purge remains exposes only what Purge still covers. Suppression of Purge temporarily exposes the other currently lawful result while the original deadline continues; no replay, refund or new application results on resumption. One Purge-family application per target across casters: a new failed-save eligible application replaces the prior record and its unused duration, not two stacked shifts. A saved-against/countered/no-eligible-record application does not itself replace another valid record; ordinary cast-start concentration displacement is separate and is never reversed. Expiry, dispel, caster death/incapacity or loss of required concentration ends this application. An unnamed future alignment effect still needs its own actual interaction; this one named exception creates no universal priority taxonomy and interprets no cosmology.
workedCases: DI7-07-A: A paid legal cast atDC17 receives target WIS16 and two defined axes; absent actual immunity it establishes Neutral/Neutral for a concentration60 seconds. An applicable current-effective predicate reads those values. Acquired oath, class, views, conduct and ability opportunities remain unchanged. WIS17 negates with cost kept. Hidden undefined axes are not fabricated as Neutral and their absence is not disclosed by free preflight.

DI7-07-B: Target baseline is Lawful Good; another caster first establishes a Suggestion toward Chaotic Evil, recording fixed Neutral/Neutral. Purge from a separate caster then covers it. A new Good-oriented Suggestion target baseline excludes both older Suggestion and Purge; a Lawful Good caster finds no changed axes and creates no replacement. Later genuine underlying Neutral Evil change survives. End Purge while older Suggestion remains: its fixed Neutral/Neutral still applies. End that Suggestion: the lawful underlying Neutral Evil appears, not the old Lawful Good snapshot. Separate casters/actual concentration permissions are required for the fixture.

completeSharedRules.casting:
KEEP all seven actual ordinary identities as Divination rank 7, Action, V/S/F and base 17 RP, with Mass Revelation range 60 feet and the other six range 120 feet under their exact targeting interpretations below. Ordinary access is Cleric/Wizard class 13 and Mirrorsage/Shaman class 19, not total level or possession of 17 RP. Actual acquisition, repertoire/preparation, provider retention, legal action, components, body, target and current casting restrictions remain mandatory. In particular Bloodcaller's actual loss of ordinary Shaman casting is not waived; Oracle RC and other same-named class/feat/item permissions grant none of these ordinary spells. Actual class focus and S-hand compatibility apply; no costly material, generic upcast, new school placement or resource pool is invented. Read the original generating source fields without normalizing absence/null.

KEEP the reviewed ordinary sequence: verify legality; price from actual pre-cast state using the selected route and every applicable independent cost/modifier; commit costs, components, concentration transition and beginning strain/Refrain exactly once; then resolve legal interrupts and the surviving effect. Failed, protected, saved-against and countered committed casts refund nothing. Ordinary saves are binary meet-DC without natural shifts; an actual Counterspell check uses Core task degrees/natural shifts collapsed to success/failure, DC 10 + twice the triggering cast's actual rank. Generic Automatic or opposed as described creates no free save, identification roll or invented opposed DC. No information spell grants a Reaction, target sight or a new interruption trigger. Fate Echo's explicitly NEW two-commitment exception below is the only new casting bridge here; no other copy mechanism inherits it.
completeSharedRules.information:
KEEP source-authorized hidden but established world facts as readable information. An authoritative Director-established fact does not need a pre-existing software log or a caster-known document; conversely, a source file, nonempty story label or fixture is not proof of an actual campaign fact. The spell's scope authorizes disclosure, not invention of an otherwise undefined history, actor, faction or operation. Missing data is not zero, Neutral, nonmembership, absence of a trap or proof of an empty past. Preserve exact fact source, version, time precision and audience separately from the current query.

Read every unprotected fact the individual spell promises; do not reduce all activities/history to one favored record or an arbitrary sample. A specific protection applies only to the information, subject, generating school/rank and time scope it actually covers. Protection of one person does not conceal independent institutional/environmental facts, and protected personal facts cannot be relabeled institution/effect history to evade the protection. Supply independently meaningful readable fields. Indeterminate does not identify the hidden reason, number of withheld records or protection. If existence itself is protected, disclose no placeholder, ID gap, total or count derived from that protected existence. Claim No qualifying fact only where absence itself is established and readable; otherwise do not certify completeness beyond the readable facts. An explicitly permitted masking effect retains its own false/altered-result rule; do not override it with a generic truthful-result assertion.

Equivalent paid inquiries under materially unchanged facts, authority and applicable protections give consistent overlapping information across casters/rephrasing. Genuine new events, changed protections or new established evidence can change later paid answers. Knowledge itself supplies no skill success, disarm, control, consent, authority, spell acquisition or free communication. KEEP the reviewed observer-specific location rule: a revealed actual location ends Hidden for that observer and removes Invisible's own attack modifiers for that observer; it does not end Invisible or grant sight. Independent darkness, blindness, smoke and other actual modifiers remain. Communicated information requires a real channel and grants only what was actually communicated. Public teaching/procedure projection never publishes the internal fact/protection/donor dossiers or private membership merely because the rule can query them.
completeSharedRules.timeAndIdentity: KEEP exact event/cast/application identities and source-specific budgets. NEW DI7 sustained durations explicitly specified as 60 elapsed seconds begin at effect resolution, use an absolute phase-0 endpoint, and never reset on extra turns, initiative changes, absence, scene changes or transfer of a token. At that endpoint the effect is unavailable for a new event. Vision Quest's normal completion is its expressly defined completion-and-answer event, not an interruption; same-time competing events use existing timestamp/phase/application-sequence order. Existing counterpart durations, especially Alignment Suggestion's preserved marker rule, are unchanged. Suppression and restoration never replay missed notices or refund spent uses; each exact DI7 procedure states its own continuation or termination. Source death, incapacity, concentration and real suppression are distinct: no universal death-ending rule is imported into an independently attached nonconcentration ward. Keep one concentration slot except an independently acquired, actually paid source-specific exception. Hard denial, damage roots, prevention/transfer stages, real providers and material histories remain the existing rules, not a copy-created replacement engine.
completeSharedRules.examples: All examples are authored conditional adjudications, not actual campaign receipts, full spell-runtime tests or human balance evidence. Unless expressly changed, use an actually entitled single-class Wizard 13, INT +4, PB 5, actual spell DC 17 before separately applicable bonuses, maximum/current RP 48/48, a legal prepared spell, working arcane focus/S hand and audible V. Ordinary Limit is 11. The 17-RP quotations assume pre-cast Dissonance below 11 and no actual price modifiers. A first distinct prepared matrix may waive only its own base strain; its actual encounter history must be specified. A Fate Echo nested copy is the NEW copied-spell route, not another prepared matrix. Explicit example state is a conditional premise, not proof that an arbitrary character has those features, resources, targets or world facts.

DI7-SHAMAN-VENT-01 — Shaman vent checkpoint. Evaluate the Shaman’s once-per-round ordinary-spell totem vent at casting-sequence step 5, after step 4 has committed the cast and established any required concentration, ending incompatible prior concentration. Use the caster’s actual position, the actual ownership and active state of the totem aura, this cast’s qualifying ordinary Shaman spell route, and that Shaman’s existing once-per-round use history at this checkpoint. Do not retain a pre-commit aura snapshot.

The first qualifying ordinary spell cast while inside at least one of that Shaman’s own still-active totem auras automatically occupies the round’s opportunity and generates 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0. This remains the first qualifying cast even when its generated Dissonance was already 0; it does not remove accumulated Dissonance or preserve the opportunity for a later spell. An earlier cast outside an own active aura, or through an excluded route, does not occupy this opportunity.

Establishing incompatible concentration at step 4 ends the shared totem burden and its auras before this determination. That cast therefore receives no totem vent and does not occupy the first-inside opportunity. A later counter, failed result, aura restoration or movement does not replay the checkpoint, refund an occupied opportunity or restore displaced concentration. Multiple own overlapping totems provide only one reduction and share the Shaman’s one round opportunity; another Shaman’s aura does not qualify.

An ordinary Fate Echo outer cast may qualify independently. Its fate-echo-copy child is not an ordinary learned Shaman spell and neither receives nor occupies this ordinary-spell-only vent. A concentration-requiring child ends incompatible totems at its own commitment, without undoing the outer cast’s earlier valid vent. A readied outer cast must account for its actual held-spell concentration; a nonconcentration payload does not exempt its Ready hold from concentration displacement. Release supplies no second outer casting or vent checkpoint.

The vent grants no RP reduction, does not revise already committed RP, and cannot bypass pre-commit casting restrictions. Fate’s required forecast and later child revalidation still use the actual chronological strain and resource state under their existing rules. The existing source-governed round boundary remains unchanged.

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within30feet and line of effect. No requirement that its alignment be known; hidden canonical axes are resolved after paid casting.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to1minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; an already-passed start never counts. Outside initiative, expires after 60 elapsed seconds. Retain the original virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence and planar travel; moving between timing modes does not reset it.
operational.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new overlay. Failure: snapshot your actual current alignment orientation. For each axis defined both for you and for the target, compute one step toward your snapshotted value along Lawful–Neutral–Chaotic and Good–Neutral–Evil. Compute the target baseline without any previous Alignment Suggestion overlay on that target and, under the explicitly NEW DI7 AP-AS-01 exception, without any Alignment Purge overlay on that target. Under the NEW scoped AC4-ALIGN-01 exception, also exclude all Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor overlays on this target when computing this baseline. Retain all other independent actual alignment effects/records. This target-only exclusion does not change the caster-orientation snapshot: an actual Purge on the caster still supplies Neutral/Neutral, subject to that caster's own active AC4 Lock/Anchor snapshot for the final effective read. An unsuppressed Purge on the target covers the resulting live Suggestion values until Purge ends or is suppressed; an eligible active Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor snapshot applies last under AC4-ALIGN-01, without deleting, pausing or refreshing these lower records. An already matching or undefined axis gains no changed-value overlay. If at least one axis changes, replace the prior same-spell overlay with the new recorded axis values/deadline. A failed-save cast that changes no defined axis creates no new overlay and does not itself replace a valid older one; mandatory concentration transitions remain independent.
operational.effect: The changed values are the target’s actual effective canonical alignment for rules that query those axes during the overlay, including real alignment-gated spells/items. Example: baseline Chaotic Evil targeted by a Lawful Good caster becomes Neutral Neutral; one such overlay never jumps two steps. Its values remain fixed until expiry/removal/replacement and do not recompute every time another underlying record changes. Unchanged/unoverlaid axes follow their actual underlying records. An independent effect such as Corrupted can change underlying alignment while this spell persists; that change remains and is exposed when the applicable overlay ends. One Alignment Suggestion overlay per target across casters; recasting cannot use its old overlay as a staircase for another same-spell step. NEW scoped AC4-ALIGN-01: effective-alignment reads evaluate this live Suggestion overlay and the reviewed AP-AS-01 Purge interaction first, then apply the eligible active Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor snapshot last. Lock/Anchor ending or inactivity exposes the then-live lower result with its original history/deadline; no ended overlay is restored. This adds no general alignment priority system.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: The spell grants no automatic knowledge of either character’s axes, including whether a value changed. Actual information protections still govern observations. It never compels matching behavior, belief, confession, loyalty, PvP, personality or oathbreaking; conduct clauses still judge actual conduct. Ending removes only this overlay, without restoring an old alignment snapshot, deleting independent changes or reviving a replaced overlay. Caster orientation is fixed at application, not tracked through later caster changes. Ward tag creates no ward. More specific alignment-changing effects retain their actual interaction rules; this card does not invent a general priority engine for every unrelated overlay. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,M/F as focus, WIS, concentration minute and actual push toward caster alignment. NEW: temporary canonical one-step overlay on both eligible axes. Exact-review proposals: compute without previous same-spell overlay to prevent recast ratcheting, overlay only genuinely changed axes, fixed values, and no new application when no defined axis changes; independent base changes survive ending.
